agency: Department of Housing and Urban Development
summary: HUD responded that Environmental Statements will be filed for Phase III projects through regular HUD program channels, and that there are no appropriate mechanisms beyond general economy controls to regulate free market activities of producers in resource utilization.
text: Response: As noted in the text, Environmental Statements will be filed for Phase III projects through regular HUD program channels. There are no appropriate mechanisms to control free market activities of the producers in resource utilization other than those available for the general economy.
opening_anchor: Response: As noted in the text, Environmental Statements will be filed for Phase III projects through regular HUD program channels.
closing_anchor: There are no appropriate mechanisms to control free market activities of the producers in resource utilization other than those available for the general economy.
